from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
def run(w, Tlist):
    Tb={'1':np.ones_like(t),'sin':np.sin(w*t),'cos':np.cos(w*t),'t':t}
    feats=[(a,b) for a in Pb for b in Tlist]
    X=np.c_[[Pb[a]*Tb[b] for a,b in feats]].T
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((X@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), feats, c
Pb={'1':np.ones_like(P),'P':P,'P2':P**2,'1/P':1/P}
